questions_and_answers.question_text: Tāmen guǎn zhèige gōngshè jiào shénme? Dānzishang yǒu méiyou xiězhe?

answers.answer_text: What do they call this commune? Is it written on the list?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiězhe ne, jiào "Sìjìqīng."

answers.answer_text: Yes, it's called Sìjìqīng.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèige gōngshè shíwǔge dàduìde chǎnliàng dōu zhème gāo ma?

answers.answer_text: Is the output this high in all fifteen brigades of this commune?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Chàbuduō, zài shāndìde liǎngge dàduì, chǎnliàng shǎo yìdiǎnr.

answers.answer_text: Almost. The two brigades in the mountains have somewhat lower outputs.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Běijīng jiāoqū shēngchǎn yìzhǒng yǒu míngde dàozi, jiào shénme?

answers.answer_text: There's a famous kind of rice produced in the suburbs of Běijīng. What's it called?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jiào Jīngxīdào. Běijīngde jīng, dōng-xī-nán-běide xī.

answers.answer_text: It's called Jīngxīdào. Jīng as in Běijīng, xī as in dōng-xī-nán-běi.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Quánguó yígòng yǒu jǐge píngyuán?

answers.answer_text: How many flatland regions are there in the whole country?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Miànjī bǐjiào dàde yǒu sìge, dōu shi shēngchǎn liángshide zhǔyào dìqū.

answers.answer_text: There are four which are relatively large; all of them are major grain-producing regions.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nèige shēngchǎn shūcàide dàduì zhǐ yǒu liùshí hù!

answers.answer_text: The brigade that produces vegetables has only sixty households!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, èrbǎiduōkǒu rén měinián mài gěi guójiā bù shǎode cài na!

answers.answer_text: Yes, for two hundred people, they sell a lot of vegetables to the state every year!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiànzài, gǎo jīngjì jiànshè hái shi Zhōngguó rénmín zuì zhòngyàode gōngzuò a!

answers.answer_text: Today, engaging in economic construction is still the most important work of the Chinese people!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì, suīrán zhèixiē nián fāzhǎn sùdù hěn kuài, kěshi jīngjì hái shi wǒmende gōngzuò zhòngdiǎn.

answers.answer_text: Yes, although the pace of development has been very fast the past few years, the economy is still the main focus of our work.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hē! Nǐmende càidì shōude bù shǎo a!

answers.answer_text: Wow! You've harvested quite a lot from your vegetable plots!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jiù shi ma, měimǔ dì dōu shōu yíwànduō jīn na!

answers.answer_text: Sure, we harvested over ten thousand catties from each mǔ of land!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèige gōngshè jīxièhuà yǐhòu, mǔchǎn tígāole duōshao?

answers.answer_text: Since this commune was mechanized, how much has the yield per mǔ been increased?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tígāole yíbàn duō yìdiǎn, chàbuduō bǎifēnzhī wǔshiyī.

answers.answer_text: It was raised a little more than half, about fifty-one percent.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ jiù cānguānle "Sìjìqīng"? Biéde jǐge xiānjìn gōngshè ne? Shénme shíhou qù ya?

answers.answer_text: You've only visited Sìjìqīng? How about the other advanced communes? When are you going to them?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Guò jǐtiān jiù qù, péi jǐwèi nóngyè zhuānjiā yìqǐ qù.

answers.answer_text: We'll be going in a few days. We're going with several specialists in agriculture.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèige dìqūde nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu shénme tèdiǎn ma?

answers.answer_text: Is there anything distinctive about the agricultural production of this region?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen shìzhe zǔzhīle jǐge zhuānyèhuàde gōngshè, tāmende shēngchǎn bǐjiào yǒu tèdiǎn.

answers.answer_text: We have organized a few specialized communes on a trial basis. Their production set-up is rather distinctive.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐmen gōngshè yǒu zhème duō dà tuōlājī!

answers.answer_text: Your commune has so many large tractors!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ng, píngjūn měige dàduì èrshitái, wǒmen hái xiǎng duō mǎi jǐtái ne!

answers.answer_text: Yes, every brigade has twenty on the average, and we want to buy a few more!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Cóng túpiànshang kàn, nǐmen gōngzuòde hǎo xīnkǔ.

answers.answer_text: From the picture it looks like you're working very hard.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Méiyou shénme xīnkǔ, jiù shi zài xuéxiào hòubianr zhòng diǎnr cài.

answers.answer_text: Not so hard. We're just planting some vegetables behind the school.

questions_and_answers.question_text: zhuānyè

answers.answer_text: special line/field/discipline

questions_and_answers.question_text: jīqì (jīqi)

answers.answer_text: machine
